title: UE requested PDN connectivity procedure initiation

entities.name: UE requested PDN connectivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to request connectivity to a PDN by sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message, starting timer T3482, and entering PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING state.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to MME to request PDN connectivity. Contains various IEs including APN, PDN type, request type, ESM information transfer flag, and protocol configuration options.

entities.name: Timer T3482
entities.description: Timer started by UE when sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message. Stopped upon receiving ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST or PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING
entities.description: State entered by UE after sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message and starting timer T3482.

entities.name: Access point name IE
entities.description: Information element containing the access point name. Included in PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST or ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message under specific conditions.

entities.name: PDN type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating IP version capability (IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6) or non-IP/Ethernet.

entities.name: Request type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating type of request: initial request, emergency, handover, handover of emergency bearer services, or RLOS.

entities.name: Protocol configuration options IE
entities.description: Information element containing various protocol configuration options including PDU session ID, QoS rules support indicators, APN rate control indicators, and DNS security information.

entities.name: ESM information transfer flag
entities.description: Flag indicating UE has ESM information (protocol configuration options, APN, or both) to be sent after NAS security activation.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST with ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Condition when PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST is sent together with ATTACH REQUEST message.

entities.name: Emergency bearer services or RLOS request
entities.description: Condition when UE requests PDN connection for emergency bearer services or access to RLOS.

entities.name: Default APN usage
entities.description: Condition when UE requests connectivity using default APN, with specific rules for APN IE inclusion.

entities.name: Specific APN request
entities.description: Condition when UE requests connectivity to additional PDN using specific APN.

relations.description: Procedure involves sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.
Procedure starts timer T3482 when UE sends PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST.
Procedure requires UE to enter PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING state.
Message may contain Access point name IE under specific conditions.
Message contains PDN type IE indicating IP version capability.
Message contains request type IE indicating type of PDN connectivity request.
Message may contain protocol configuration options IE with various parameters.
Message may contain ESM information transfer flag to indicate pending ESM information.
When PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST is sent with ATTACH REQUEST, UE shall not start timer T3482.
When PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST is sent with ATTACH REQUEST, UE shall not include APN.
For emergency bearer services or RLOS requests, UE shall not include APN.
For default APN usage, UE includes APN IE only if PAP/CHAP is required, otherwise need not include.
For specific APN requests, UE shall include requested APN in the message.
ESM information transfer flag indicates UE has protocol configuration options or APN that needs to be sent after NAS security activation.
